propositions: Jira-specific REST probe logic (URL construction, basic-auth GET, status-name classification) is tightly coupled in core inbound_probe.py, violating backend neutrality and blocking a second vendor backend from dropping in
inbound_probe.py must remain at package root per ADR 0035 but should contain only neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) with Jira mechanics moved to adapters/jira/probe.py

run_differs.py:369 calls probe directly without capability dispatch, so it must be refactored to route through SupportsAbsenceProbe capability check on the backend, falling back to UNREACHABLE for backends lacking the capability
JiraBackend must implement SupportsAbsenceProbe.probe_remote() by delegating to adapters/jira/probe.py, encapsulating vendor-specific URL shape, auth resolution, and status classification
